vulnerability_title: [M-17] `LaunchToken` transfers cause staking rewards to be lost to the `LaunchPad`

recommendation.recommendation_text:
Modify lines 170 and 175 of Distributor.sol so `msg.sender` is replaced with the correct account.

[View detailed Proof of Concept](https://code4rena.com/audits/2025-08-gte-perps-and-launchpad/submissions/F-8)
